label: Independent read-only review of the merge of origin/main (juspay/kriya PR #49) into the TaskAgent branch. Reviewer findings are claims; each was re-checked against the source by the author before being accepted or rejected.

claims.claim: navigate commits the guard before a provider call and keeps the abort handling on the non-provider path
fill keeps root scoping and the redacted debug log
SelectBox fill is async, awaits the guarded sleep, checkpoints after the click, scopes lookups through the DOM root and keeps no setTimeout flow
claims.by: reviewer could not tell (split packet); author read the function and counted 0 setTimeout calls inside it

claims.claim: _fillElement awaits the SelectBox fill and uses the scoped closest
DOMActions.dispose cancels pending waits and disposes the DOM root
EnhancedFormDetector logs the masked value and uses the DOM root event options
FormRegistry dispose cancels pending selects and disposes the root; the detector gets root and config debugMode
AutomationConfig keeps redactor, root and locationProvider
strict resolution is unchanged without a scope and confined to the scope with one
jest config keeps the html2canvas mapping, clearMocks, strict options and testMatch
the dom-free test exempts only DOMRoot.ts and asserts the agent core never imports it
the new strict-root test fails if the scoping is removed
claims.by: reviewer named the assertions; author removed the scoping from strict.ts and 5 of 6 tests failed (the invalid-selector control still passed), then restored the file byte-for-byte and 6 of 6 passed

findings.finding: Provider navigation rewraps a timeout as NETWORK_ERROR and ignores the abort signal
findings.evidence: upstream tests/root.test.ts asserts NETWORK_ERROR with message 'Navigation failed: Navigation timeout after 20ms' for a provider navigation that times out (lines 524-533); lines 318-337 assert NETWORK_ERROR for a provider that throws. The resolution added guard.commit() before the provider call, outside the try, so a pre-aborted run still throws EXECUTION_CANCELLED.

findings.finding: A live DOM node is still passed to the debug logger
findings.evidence: forcelog snapshots every Element through _describe before printing (DOMActions.ts forcelog).

findings.finding: Delayed temp-link timers use the DOM root container after dispose
findings.disposition: pre-existing upstream code, unchanged by the merge, not changed

findings.finding: Scoped click path returns early and shows no guard.commit
findings.evidence: the legacy click path commits at DOMActions.ts lines 255-265, before _clickElement (line 273).

findings.disposition: pre-existing upstream design: the detector never calls DOMRoot.initialize, so it holds no listener to release

findings.finding: SelectBox timers and window.getComputedStyle remain in EnhancedFormDetector
findings.disposition: pre-existing, unchanged by the merge, not changed

findings.finding: _submitFormDirectly root path calls requestSubmit without an existence check
Found by the author, not the reviewer: the blank-value SelectBox guard in fill used an unscoped element.closest
findings.disposition: fixed (now this._dom.closest), before the source was frozen and hashed
